title: Home EV Chargers: What to Know and What They Pay
desc: What to check before you buy a home EV charger, and every open EV charger rebate we track, with the official page and the date we checked each one.
lead: A home charger fills your car overnight. Here is what to check before you buy, and which programs pay today.
image_alt: An electric car charger mounted on a wooden wall
intro:
A home EV charger plugs into your electrical system and charges your car at a steady pace, usually overnight. Most programs pay for a Level 2 charger, the kind that runs on a 240 volt circuit like an electric dryer.

The rebate rules are mostly about the charger and the wiring. Some programs pay only for certain models. Some need a licensed electrician, and some ask for a permit. A few add a bonus if your charger can pause charging at busy times. Read the program page before you buy, because the charger on sale today may not be on the list.
checks: Is the model on the list? Many programs pay only for chargers on their own qualified list.
Your panel. Ask an electrician if your panel has room for a new 240 volt circuit. An upgrade can cost more than the charger.
A licensed electrician. Most programs ask for one, and some also ask for a permit.
Smart charging. Some programs pay more for a charger that can follow the utility's off-peak hours.
Homes and condos. Rules differ for houses, townhomes and condos. Check the program page for your home type.
faq: Do I need a Level 2 charger?
Not always. A regular outlet works for short daily trips, but it is slow. A Level 2 charger is faster, and it is what most rebates cover.
Can I get a rebate if I rent or live in a condo?
Some programs include tenants with the owner's consent and some have a separate multi-unit program. Check the official page for your home type.
Sometimes. A few programs include wiring and a panel upgrade, but many pay only for the charger. The table links to each program.
Pick your province or state in the rebate finder, then ask two electricians for a quote on the same charger.
